# Real Elite Contracting

> Veteran-owned general contractor serving West Virginia's Eastern Panhandle,
> Frederick County MD, Winchester VA, and Loudoun County / Northern Virginia.
> Remodeling and exterior craftsmanship — "Military Precision. Civilian Excellence."

Real Elite Contracting holds WV Contractor License WV062432 and Virginia Class A
Contractor 2705198604 (HIC, residential). Frederick MD is a service-area mention,
not a Maryland licensing claim. The company is veteran-owned and is pursuing
SDVOSB (Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business) certification — that certification
is in progress, not yet awarded. There is no publicly published founding date, and the
company does not display fabricated review ratings: star/aggregate ratings appear only
when mirrored from the verified Google Business Profile.

## Service areas
- WV Eastern Panhandle: Martinsburg, Inwood, Charles Town, Ranson, Hedgesville, Shepherdstown
- Maryland: Frederick
- Virginia: Winchester, Leesburg, Ashburn, Loudoun County, Fairfax County,
  Prince William County, and Northern Virginia luxury markets
  (McLean, Great Falls, Vienna, Oakton, Dunn Loring, Reston, Fort Hunt, Middleburg, Old Town Alexandria).
  Loudoun town pages also cover Purcellville, Round Hill, Lovettsville, Waterford,
  Hamilton, Aldie, Lansdowne, South Riding, and Sterling.
  Prince William town pages cover Haymarket, Gainesville, Bristow, and Nokesville.
  Headquarters stay in Martinsburg, WV. No local office is claimed in those counties.
- Full list: https://www.realelitecontracting.com/service-areas
